author: The Current
description:
Singer-songwriter jeremy messersmith wonders if people will share a cookie at the Minnesota State Fair
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter jeremy messersmith was curious whether people at the Minnesota State Fair would be willing to share one of their fresh chocolate-chip cookies if someone were simply to ask. So jeremy decided to put that idea to the test. In an unscientific but delicious experiment, jeremy posted himself near Sweet Martha's Cookies flagship location at the State Fair, and he intrepidly approached fairgoers to ask for a cookie. Watch the video to see how he did.

Watch Medium Build perform "Crying Over U" in The Current studio
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Medium Build — aka Nick Carpenter — is set to release a new album, "King of Having Fun," on September 4, 2026, on @islandrecords.

Ahead of the album’s release, Medium Build visited The Current studio to play a solo acoustic set of songs, including “Crying Over U,” above, from his 2024 album, "Country."

Watch and listen to the full session here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ocJHurpaBg

author: The Current
description:
Watch Durry perform an acoustic version of "Polaroid" at the Minnesota State Fair
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Minnesota musicians Durry — siblings Taryn and Austin Durry — performed an acoustic set at the MPR State Fair Station during The Current Morning Show in the Afternoon. Here they are performing an acoustic version of their song, "Polaroid," with Austin taking a tip from another Minnesota musician, Bob Dylan, by rocking a harmonica during the instrumental break.
